mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file ( file_uploader, file_name, file_path, target_type, target_id ) VALUES ( #{file_uploader}, #{file_name}, #{file_path}, #{target_type}, #{target_id} )
mapper.select: SELECT file_id, file_uploader, file_name, file_path, target_type, target_id FROM file WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY file_id ASC
SELECT file_id, file_uploader, file_name, file_path, target_type, target_id FROM file WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM file WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
